resources.name: SSSP efficiency pseudopotentials (In, Se)

access.notes: Recommended ultrasoft or PAW pseudopotentials for In and Se from the SSSP efficiency library (version 1.3 or later).

resources.notes: Provide accurate DFT results for the monolayer α-In₂Se₃ system.

resources.name: Monolayer α-In₂Se₃ crystal structure

access.notes: Hexagonal unit cell with a ≈ 4.05 Å. Se layers in ABC stacking; the middle Se position governs polarization. Can be built from standard crystallographic data (e.g., ICSD entries, previous literature) or generated using crystallographic software.

resources.notes: Initial structure required for DFT calculations; not a proprietary dataset.
